title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.20397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic large language models (LLMs) on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) re-encode verbose tool schemas every turn, so prefill - quadratic in sequence length - dominates time-to-first-token (TTFT) as the tool registry grows. Nexus's primary lever is to decouple routing from the schema-prefill cost: an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer (SLB) with a calibrated cross-encoder margin gate selects tools by retrieval, and arguments are generated over a compressed textual signature (median 19 tokens) rather than over spliced key/value (KV) cache. This path is depth-independent: routing accuracy stays near 89% as the registry scales to 250 tools - where a concatenate-all-schemas baseline overflows the context window entirely - and it reaches a first-argument token 1.66x sooner than a full-schema re-prefill at a ~80% main-context token saving. As a secondary, bounded lever we transplant a compiled schema KV block directly into the live context. This

translated_title: Nexus：面向统一内存上智能体大语言模型的深度自适应KV缓存拼接与检索解耦工具路由
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20397v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的智能体大语言模型（LLM）在每轮交互中都会重新编码冗长的工具模式，因此，随着工具注册表规模的增长，预填充阶段（其计算复杂度随序列长度呈二次方增长）成为影响首令牌时间（TTFT）的主要因素。Nexus的主要策略是将路由与模式预填充成本解耦：一个带有校准交叉编码器边际门控的INT8语义旁路缓冲区（SLB）通过检索选择工具，而参数生成则基于压缩的文本签名（中位数19个令牌），而非拼接的键值（KV）缓存。该路径具有深度无关性：当注册表扩展到250个工具时，路由准确率仍保持在89%左右——而此时，一个拼接所有模式的基线方法会完全溢出上下文窗口——并且，与完整模式重新预填充相比，它达到首个参数令牌的时间快1.66倍，同时节省约80%的主上下文令牌。作为次要且受限的策略，我们将一个编译好的模式KV块直接移植到实时上下文中。这……
tldr: Nexus通过解耦工具路由与模式预填充成本，利用语义旁路缓冲区和压缩签名实现深度无关的高效工具选择，在扩展到250个工具时保持89%准确率，并显著降低延迟和上下文占用。
en_tdlr: Nexus decouples tool routing from schema-prefill costs via a semantic lookaside buffer and compressed signatures, achieving depth-independent efficiency with 89% accuracy at 250 tools, while cutting latency and main-context token usage.
